title: Subperiodic groups and bounded automorphisms of periodic graphs
summary: A subperiodic group is a group of motions of $d$-dimensional Euclidean space $\R^d$ which contains a translation lattice $\Z^r$ of rank $r < d$ as a subgroup of finite index. A classification into abstract group isomorphism classes is performed for subperiodic groups in dimension~3: 75 \emph{crystallographic} rod groups ($r=1$) and 80 layer groups ($r=2$) are shown to belong to 32 and 34 isomorphism classes, respectively.
